APPLICATION SOURCE AND ADAPTED HELPERS

Repository: https://github.com/CrispStrobe/brickwright-lite
Revision: 0a23bd8446f3cdb9a51668ea17dedb054648480a
License: BSD-3-Clause, reproduced in licenses/brickwright-source.txt.

The geometric helper section in source/check_model_mesh.mjs is copied
unchanged from test/bw-sim-models-solid.test.mjs at that revision, with
attribution preserved. The single-model wrapper/report is authored here.
The runtime check imports the real compiler, public model preparation,
Robot Lab controller/extension, and the app's official test-clock helper.
No whole application checkout, dependency installation or binary runtime
is included in this package.

EXTERNAL STANDARD LDRAW GEOMETRY

The 13 placed part types resolve to 213 standard LDraw files. Those files
are external dependencies, not redistributed inside the LDR/MPD or ZIP.
The model references standard components; it does not claim authorship
of their meshes. The CAD illustration is rendered from those components.
The layout/assembly is new; the underlying component geometry is unchanged.

LDraw source: https://library.ldraw.org/library/updates/complete.zip
Recorded source date: 2026-09-30
Source SHA256: f3e496d0ede69ca7942fa4aa198e661ee2d22723906101e2e339d8917a4dd5f2

The selected files are licensed under CC BY 4.0; some also offer CC BY 2.0.
This package uses the CC BY 4.0 option. See licenses/CAreadme.txt and
licenses/CAlicense4.txt; the inherited CC BY 2.0 text is also preserved.
License link: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/

NATIVE RUNTIME DEPENDENCIES

Exact dependency versions and resolved package integrity values are in
source/runtime/package-lock.json. They retain their respective package
licenses and must be obtained separately. Key dependencies are Scratch VM
4.8.115, Scratch render/audio, JSZip and the selected custom Jolt build.
The test environment and operative Jolt integrity are in
evidence/environment.json.

SUPPLIED COLLECTION

The source catalog is the user's corrected 53-assembly collection. Its 61
entries are preserved unchanged in the merged catalog. Existing model
files and their notices remain in the supplied collection; this add-on
only contains the new model and additive metadata. Source identities are
recorded in evidence/source-identities.json.

The educational idea of a pantograph is not a claim of a new mechanical
invention. This particular assembly, experiment and integration package
were developed for the supplied collection.
